result.claim: The skill advertises zero-configuration memory recall that uses semantic vector search after indexing, automatically falls back to keyword search, retrieves file content, indexes memory files, and reports status. It describes its embeddings as 100% local with no API calls.

claim_evidence.quote:
Smart memory search that **automatically selects the best method**:
- **Vector search** (semantic, high quality) when synced
- **Built-in search** (keyword, fast) as fallback
